prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Primary request: Redraw the child's original RAINBOW PING and her CAT from reference image 1 in the polished 3D Catch! Teenieping style of the MyStarQuest project.
Input roles: image 1 is the authoritative character-design sketch. It is photographed SIDEWAYS: mentally rotate the drawing 90 degrees counterclockwise so the crown is above the face, feet below, and the cat beside her. Images 2 and 3 are Aurora and Heart from the project, ONLY references for Teenieping proportions, big glossy eyes, sculpted rounded hair, material finish and studio rendering. Do not substitute their outfits or faces for the drawn design.
Preserve the original drawing's identifiable inventions. Rainbow Ping has a huge softly rounded head, enormous dark glossy sparkling eyes, pale cream face, little smiling mouth, tiny body, short arms and little violet shoes. Tall three-point GOLD crown decorated with red heart jewels, a green triangular jewel on one point, a large pink central jewel with a cyan star setting, and a pink jewel on the other point. Below the crown a small pale diamond forehead ornament with a red heart. Long voluminous hair falls to either side: purple/lilac on one side, pink on the other, with cobalt-blue outer streaks and pale yellow accents as drawn. Translate the colored pencil masses into beautifully sculpted soft rounded locks, keeping the distinctive multicolor arrangement. Her little flared robe/dress has a pink panel and pale yellow/ivory panel, vivid turquoise V-shaped trim down the front and a gold oval royal emblem on a white belly/chest panel, directly inspired by the drawing.
She holds the long PINK magic wand shown in the sketch, topped with a RED HEART outline surrounding a cream/gold heart inset and a little blue-green central gem. Hold the wand at a friendly upward diagonal so its complete heart tip is visible and the face unobstructed. One small hand grips it, other arm relaxed.
Include her CAT sitting right beside her feet, about one third her height: sweet cream-and-golden-orange cartoon kitten based on the gold line drawing, oversized round head, two pointed ears, big friendly eyes, tiny triangular nose, little whiskers, slim gold-striped chest, rounded front paws, seated hindquarters, and a thin curling tail. It must be clearly a cat companion. No extra accessories or invented costume on cat.
Style: polished high-quality 3D children's animation matching the supplied project Teeniepings, giant head about 60% of body height, tiny creature proportions, soft sculpted hair, gentle gloss, pastel-rich colors, soft studio lighting. A faithful finished adaptation of this child's drawing, not a generic rainbow fairy.
Composition: upright full-body Rainbow Ping and full-body cat together, clear balanced centered silhouette, entire crown, hair, wand, feet and tail visible, generous transparent margin all around. Genuine transparent background. No paper, table, photograph shadows, scenery, text, watermark, borders, other characters, or unrelated props.
